question_cn: 为避免被博登杀，以下哪种做法最有效？
question_en: What is the most effective way to prevent Boden's mate?

options.text_cn: 换掉对方的一个象，破坏双象配合
options.text_en: Trade off one of the opponent's bishops to break up the bishop pair
Advance the king toward the center of the board

options.text_cn: 不要让己方棋子堵死王的逃格，同时避免随手走兵打开对角线
options.text_en: Keep the king's escape squares open and avoid careless pawn moves that open a bishop's diagonal

options.text_cn: 多发展马，马可以跳过棋子保护王
options.text_en: Develop more knights because they can jump over pieces to protect the king

explanation_cn: 防范博登杀有两个要点：第一，不让己方棋子封死王的逃格；第二，走棋前检查对方的象是否对准己方王，避免随手走兵打开危险的对角线。换掉一个象也有效，但并非总能做到。
explanation_en: There are two main defenses: keep the king's escape squares open, and check whether an enemy bishop is aimed at your king before making a pawn move that could open the diagonal. Trading off one bishop also helps, though it may not always be possible.
